data.name: THUGGING
data.detailed_description:
THUGGING is a third-person shoot ’em up set in a lawless city where crime, drugs, and gambling control everything.

The streets are stained with blood, and only the most ruthless make it out alive.

Revenge, Retribution and maybe ... a second chance?

You’re fresh out of prison with one thing on your mind — revenge.

The city that turned its back on you hasn’t changed, and it’s still crawling with thugs, gangs, and dirty criminals standing in your way.

With weapons in hand and nothing to lose, you’ll fight your way through the streets, leaving chaos behind as you climb back to the top.

The only question is, how far will you go for revenge and how much drug money can you steal?!

Features: 

  • Shoot, Steal, Survive – Engage in relentless 3rd Person shootouts, kill armed thugs, and keep stacking dirty cash in your hideout

  • Muscle Car Rides – Cruise the city in style, traveling from one place to another while catching your breath between fights and discovering your old town

  • Revenge-Driven Story – Fresh out of jail, with nothing left to lose, your future is written in bullets and blood

This isn't just survival; it's about taking back what's yours. Your story is one of blood, bullets and drug money.

The city offers no mercy and neither will you!

data.short_description: THUGGING is a 3rd Person Shoot 'em up set in a dystopian city fueled by drugs and gambling. Inspired by classic 3D retro games it tries to capture this unique oldschool ambient in a semi open world setting. Steal money, kill thugs and get away in your car!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Super (VRAM 8 GB) / Radeon RX 5700XT (8GB
  • Storage: 6.4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: We couldn't really test on lower requiremenst than this. It probably runs on lower specs as well, but we chose this just to be safe
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080Ti (VRAM 12 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 6800XT (VRAM 16 GB
  • Storage: 6.4 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
- Explict Violence as means to reach the Game Goals showing blood, violent kills and executions
- the Story depicts death, betrayal, revenge and violence inside the drug/ narcotics trade
- a nightmarish alter ego leads the Player through the game almost like a narrator
- illegal drugs are shown as a commodity but can not be used by the Player intentionally
- casual consumption of alcohol and tobacco are implied but can not be actively engaged with by the Player
